title: A new feature for my blog, built using my voice
content: I shipped a new feature for my blog today: the Newsletters page, which offers an index of all of the newsletters I've sent out, both my free weekly Substack and my monthly sponsors-only updates. I built the feature almost entirely using my voice, chatting away to my laptop while I cooked dinner. Codex voice mode I used the ChatGPT desktop app for this, in the Codex tab, using the voice conversation mode, running against a local development environment. Here's what that looks like: I started the session against my local simonwillisonblog checkout by typing: Start dev server and open in browser This gave me a preview of the site that it would be working on, and meant that I could later ask it to show me the new pages so I could visually track its progress. Then I clicked the "Start new voice chat" button - that's not the microphone button, it's the one to the right of it - and set my laptop up in the kitchen so I could talk to it while I cooked. title: 30 Creators Tested What Claude Opus 5.5 Can Do with One Vague Prompt
content: I asked everyone to start with the same short prompt. The reported satisfaction scores ranged from 0 to 9.5 out of 10.
author: Karo (Product with Attitude)
summary_zh: 作者让30位创作者都用同一个简短、模糊的提示词测试 Claude Opus 5.5。大家给出的满意度从0到9.5分（满分10分）不等，说明同一个模型面对模糊指令时，输出质量和用户体验差别很大。这篇内容可以帮助理解提示词写得清不清楚对 Opus 5.5 输出效果的影响，但摘要只给了结论，具体案例和方法细节不多。

title: ttok 1.0
content: Release: ttok 1.0 I released ttok 0.4 , ran uv tool upgrade ttok , piped a file into the new version... and realized that it was defaulting to the GPT-4 tokenizer when it should very clearly default to GPT-5/GPT-6 instead! I figured switching the default was a reasonable excuse to finally ship a 1.0. OpenAI haven't actually confirmed that GPT-6 uses the same tokenizer as the GPT-5 family yet - there's an angry issue about it - but I found this commit by William Liu which reports on an experiment he ran confirming that the tokenizers are likely the same: All seven GPT models (5.5, 5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna, 6 Astra/Sol/Luna) report 44,794 tokens and match each other on every one of the 31 fixtures. GPT-6 introduces no input-count change on this corpus. Tags: projects , ai , openai , generative-ai , llms , tokenization
summary_zh: Simon Willison 发布了 ttok 1.0，这是一个统计和截断 token 的命令行工具。新版本把默认分词器从 GPT-4 改成了 GPT-5/GPT-6。OpenAI 尚未正式确认 GPT-6 与 GPT-5 系列使用同一分词器，但社区实验显示 7 个 GPT 模型在 31 个测试样本上的 token 数完全一致。

title: How to Govern AI Agent Fleets Inside a Product Team
content: Building agents is getting ridiculously easy. Governing the fleet they create is the next skill product teams need.
author: Karo (Product with Attitude)
summary_zh: 文章指出构建AI Agent的门槛正在迅速降低，产品团队面临的新挑战是如何治理由此产生的大量Agent集群。核心价值在于提出了从「构建Agent」转向「治理Agent舰队」的视角，但所给内容仅为导语，具体方法论细节不足。
